title: On strengthened versions of Klee's convex body problem in Banach spaces
summary: In a recent article, Cheng, Jiang and Yuan gave an affirmative answer to Klee's convex bodies problem of Banach spaces in the sense of strict convexity and Gâteaux smoothness. In this paper, we continue to study this problem in strong senses, such as local uniform convexity, uniform convexity, Fréchet smoothness and uniform smoothness.
